3: before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasse, stir up your power, and come to deliver us.
4: Turn us, O God, and cause your face to shine; and we shall be delivered.
5: O Lord God of hosts, how long are you angry with the prayer of your servant?
6: You will feed us with bread of tears; and will cause us to drink tears by measure.
7: You have made us a strife to our neighbors; and our enemies have mocked at us.
8: Turn us, O Lord God of hosts, and cause your face to shine; and we shall be saved. Pause.
9: You have transplanted a vine out of Egypt: you have cast out the heathen, and planted it.
10: You made a way before it, and did cause its roots to strike, and the land was filled [with it].
11: Its shadow covered the mountains, and its shoots [equalled] the goodly cedars.
12: It sent forth its branches to the sea, and its shoots to the river.
13: Therefore have you broken down its hedge, while all that pass by the way pluck it?
14: The boar out of the wood has laid it waste, and the wild beast has devoured it.
15: O God of hosts, turn, we pray you: look on [us] from heaven, and behold and visit this vine;
16: and restore that which your right hand has planted: and look on the son of man whom you did strengthen for yourself.
17: [It is] burnt with fire and dug up: they shall perish at the rebuke of your presence.
18: Let your hand be upon the man of your right hand, and upon the son of man whom you did strengthen for yourself.
19: So will we not depart from you: you shall quicken us, and we will call upon your name.
20: Turn us, O Lord God of hosts, and make your face to shine; and we shall be saved.
